title: LabelRelease
description: An immutable snapshot of an external authority's ground truth at a recorded ingest time. Separate from DatasetRelease because labels are exogenous and revisable (ADR-0007).

authority.description: Who published these labels. Recorded because labels come from a different mission than the observations they label (L-09).

ingest_time.description: Not nullable, unlike an Observation's: a label release is created by this system, so the moment it was taken is always known.

supersedes_digest.description: The prior release this revises, or null for the first. A revision produces a new release; the prior one is retained and remains addressable.
